_doc: Ground-truth answer key for synthetic fixtures. Markers are matched as substrings against a candidate's commit subjects. PR-style markers use the parenthesized form '(#NN)' to avoid '#1' matching '#12'.

known_limitation.note: Cross-module grpc adoption shares no files, only the 'grpc' concept. Deterministic clustering cannot merge these; this is the documented v2-embeddings case. Test asserts the CURRENT (split) behavior so a future semantic clusterer flips it deliberately.
